title: Michels's own sighting at the start of his show

tellings.quote: it." And I have a similar I've seen stuff and it was right at the start of doing this show

plain: Jesse Michels says he has seen something strange in the sky himself, and that it happened right when he was starting his show. He brings it up only in passing, without saying what it looked like, where or when, as a way of telling a guest that he too has had an experience like theirs.
